test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Neha, Rati, Vishva, Charu and Sejal are sitting in a straight line, all facing the north. Charu is third to the left of Sejal. Neha is second to the right of Rati. Vishwa is second to the left of Sejal. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Sejal?
solution: **Five person: **Neha, Rati, Vishva, Charu and Sejal 1) Charu is third to the left of Sejal. 2) Vishwa is second to the left of Sejal. 3) Neha is second to the right of Rati. (Here Case 1 is eliminated because Neha is second to the right of Rati and this condition followed only in Case 2)
